entry.title: Report 016: Rules-file behaviour, claude-haiku-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5
entry.summary: We gave Claude seven popular rules files and same-length fakes. Models: claude-haiku-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5.

entry.title: Report 015: Capability-gap, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-opus-5-5
entry.summary: Skills.sh snapshot 2026-10-17: text tasks by Driftproof; Haiku 5.5 judge; eval account checked before/after runs, not during. Models: claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-opus-5-5.

entry.title: Report 014: Release drift, claude-haiku-4-5, claude-haiku-5-5
entry.summary: Claude Haiku 5.5 on the three skills and cases of Reports 009, 011 and 013, beside Claude Haiku 4.5, each run three times. Models: claude-haiku-4-5, claude-haiku-5-5.

entry.title: Report 013: Release drift, claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5, claude-sonnet-5-5
entry.summary: With the skill, Claude Sonnet 5.5 was never clearly higher or lower than Claude Opus 5.5 in nine results, and five of them had too few answers to tell. Models: claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5, claude-sonnet-5-5.

entry.title: Report 011: Release drift, claude-opus-5, claude-opus-5-5
entry.summary: Claude Opus 5.5 on the three skills and cases of Report 009, one case each, beside a fresh Claude Opus 5 arm on the same harness. Models: claude-opus-5, claude-opus-5-5.

entry.title: Report 010: Instrument comparison, claude-opus-5
entry.summary: One skill’s behavioural eval from its own repository, run ten times with the same skill text, the same eval case and the same executor model, five times under each of two Claude Code configurations. Models: claude-opus-5.

entry.title: Report 009: Instrument comparison, claude-opus-5
entry.summary: Three skills from one plugin, one case each, measured by Claude Code’s native plugin eval and by Driftproof, with the same SKILL.md bytes, task prompts and rubrics. Models: claude-opus-5.

entry.title: Report 008: Release drift, claude-fable-5-1
entry.summary: No separation was detected under the rule in the with_skill arm of either cell across the release. Models: claude-fable-5-1.

entry.title: Report 007: Instrument re-measurement, claude-fable-5, claude-sonnet-5
entry.summary: Three skills re-measured under generation sampling, with a corrected instrument. Models: claude-fable-5, claude-sonnet-5.

entry.title: Report 006: Revision drift, claude-fable-5, claude-sonnet-5
entry.summary: Three cells, one per skill upstream had revised since Report #005 pinned it, and none of the three returned a verdict. Models: claude-fable-5, claude-sonnet-5.

entry.title: Report 005: Value, claude-fable-5, claude-sonnet-5, gpt-5.6-sol
entry.summary: In 20 of 30 skill × substrate pairs at least one case cleared the effect floor with separated bands: 18 with an improving case (5 of them also with a regressing one), 2 with only a regressing case. Models: claude-fable-5, claude-sonnet-5, gpt-5.6-sol.

entry.title: Report 004: Capability-gap, claude-fable-5, claude-opus-5
entry.summary: 3 durable · 5 tier-dependent · 0 regresses · 2 no effect Models: claude-fable-5, claude-opus-5.

entry.title: Report 003: Release drift, claude-opus-4-8, claude-opus-5
entry.summary: 2 regressed · 4 improved · 0 mixed · 4 with no separation detected over 10 skills. Models: claude-opus-4-8, claude-opus-5.

entry.title: Report 002: Substrate durability, claude-sonnet-5, gpt-5.6-sol
entry.summary: Cross-provider skill durability, not a model ranking. Models: claude-sonnet-5, gpt-5.6-sol.

entry.title: Report 001: Release drift, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-sonnet-5
entry.summary: 9 of 10 skills showed a separation detected under the rule on this model pair. Models: claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-sonnet-5.
